environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS API Gateway (WebSocket API type) with a $connect route integration that enforces a custom authorizer Lambda. However, the primary mitigation is at the infrastructure layer: an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) with a local rate limit filter configured on the upgrade request path. The Envoy filter applies a token bucket of 1 request per 30-second window per source IP on HTTP UPGRADE requests to /ws/queue/*. After the first connection attempt from a given IP, subsequent UPGRADE handshakes receive HTTP 429 before reaching the application container. The Envoy configuration uses 'envoy.filters.http.local_ratelimit' with a fill_interval of 30s, max_tokens of 1, and tokens_per_fill of 1, applied via route-level virtual host matching on the upgrade header presence. The rate limit descriptor uses the 'x-forwarded-for' header value as the key, extracted via the 'envoy.filters.http.header_to_metadata' filter preceding the rate limiter in the filter chain.

config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway WebSocket API with $connect authorizer
